entries.24921b64badabe40: A company engaged in the franchise chain headquarters of "8-Ban Ramen" and restaurant management, food manufacturing and sales, and overseas expansion in Thailand and elsewhere.
entries.ce92d01341064128: This business opens stores overseas under area license agreements for restaurant franchise chains outside Japan, and imports, exports and sells food. In Thailand, the consolidated subsidiary HACHIBAN TRADING (THAILAND) CO.,LTD. imports and exports foodstuffs and other ingredients, and in Vietnam, it engages in wholesale import of food (seasonings). The equity-method affiliate DOUBLE FLOWERING CAMELLIA CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells soup and extracts in Thailand. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,539 million.
